company.name: Example Industrial Co.
company.source: invented numbers for a teaching example; no real company

thesis: Illustrative: margins recover from 12% to 14% as a pricing reset passes through, the kind of claim a real thesis must back with evidence.
Illustrative: modest growth (6% falling to 4%) is enough; the case does not rely on a re-rating.
risks: Illustrative: the margin recovery stalls; in the bear case the value falls below the price.
Illustrative: 9x EBITDA peers may be cheaper for a reason (cyclicality, leverage).
catalysts: Illustrative: two quarters of margin expansion in reported results.
